summary: Second City primitives 3/6 (#417): the after-resolution window (Reactions after a battle's resolution destroyed units and the province and settled Honor, before the winners go home; either player, alternating, only when someone holds one), a tie making both players the battle's loser, a discard-pile Reaction flag (FromDiscard), and a card-level 'will not bow from the resolution'; wires Never Safe, Redoubled Attack, Tales of Dishonor and, by generalizing Hizumi's bow reaction to a Region, Quagmire. The bow-reaction window's options are now listed by QueryActions. Rules lane; client-lane files are only the four shipped art scans and their .import files. Stacked on #416 (PR 422), itself on #415 (PR 421).
validation: Local: every test suite passes (Core incl. after-resolution 8, AI 28, server 8, transport 7; client builds); the local Godot import step exits 1 with the known f.is_null errors on unrelated existing assets, CI is authoritative. 29 mutation checks (window opening, first opportunity, each Reaction's condition, tie losers, destroyed counts, will-not-bow, effects, the discard-pile return and its listing, source-zone rule, Quagmire adjacency/owner/bowed, the bow-reaction listing, the window's close): five survived the first tests (three needed sharper tests, one a redundant clause removed), and every one now fails a named test.
remaining: Readings 13-18 for Mendon in docs/decisions/2026-09-21-second-city-primitives.md (window placement before the winners return home; Redoubled Attack performers and the will-not-bow promise; Tales' 'you destroyed' and both losers in a tie; Never Safe offered only for its own battle; Quagmire adjacency). The doc lists which of the 42 after-battle cards this window could serve (none of the others wired here) and the two other discard-return cards (Embracing Virtue, Move the Troops) that would reuse FromDiscard. Stages 4-6 (#418-#420) follow.
